subject: Kickstart: integration kickoff scheduling & attendee alignment
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Alvarez <lena@novamed.com>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@novamed.com>
Cc: Novamed Implementation Team <impl-team@novamed.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickstart: integration kickoff scheduling & attendee alignment

Hi Lena / Alex —

Thanks for choosing Redwood. We're ready to get the kickoff on the calendar and align stakeholders so we can unblock the SAML/SSO and model onboarding work. Proposed windows (all PDT):

- Tue Apr 20, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Apr 21, 13:00–14:00
- Thu Apr 22, 09:00–10:00

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) High-level architecture & integration touchpoints (15m)
3) SSO / connectivity checklist (15m)
4) Implementation milestones & owner mapping (10m)
5) Q&A / next steps (10m)

Attachments: kickoff agenda (redwood_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf) and a suggested attendee roster template (novamed_attendee_roster.csv).

Quick asks: can you confirm the preferred date/time from the three options, and who should attend from your side for SSO + infra? If helpful, here is a short poll: https://calendar.redwood.com/poll/3xq9

Once we have a time I'll send an invite with dial-in and a short prep checklist.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@novamed.com>

Hi Markus —

Thanks for the options. Wed Apr 21, 13:00–14:00 PDT works best for us. Attendees we plan to include:
- Lena Alvarez (Project Sponsor)
- Alex Moreno (Integration lead)
- Priya Shah (SSO engineer) — cc'd below separately

A couple quick items:
1) Can the agenda include a 10–15m window specifically for SSO certificate exchange and where Redwood stores metadata?
2) We prefer a shorter attendee list for the first call — only sponsor + integrator + SSO engineer + your leads. If needed, we'll expand later.

Please send the calendar invite and any pre-reads.

Appreciate it —
Alex

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Kickstart: integration kickoff scheduling & attendee alignment

Team —

Novamed confirmed Wed Apr 21, 13:00–14:00 PDT (we'll block 1h). Per Alex they want a tighter attendee list: sponsor + integrator + SSO engineer + our leads. Proposed Redwood attendees:
- Markus Klein (CS lead / host) — I'll own introductions and timeline
- Grace O'Connor (Customer Ops) — will handle run-of-show and recording
- Priyom Das (Platform PM) — please own the technical deep-dive and SSO cert exchange segment
- Olga Petrov (Solutions Eng) — please be ready for model-serving integration questions (30m)

Priyom: can you prepare a 10–15m slide with SSO metadata fields we need, and a checklist for network/firewall rules? I attached the draft agenda (redwood_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf) and a starter attendee roster (novamed_attendee_roster.csv). Once Priyom confirms I'll send the calendar invite and include the Zoom link + shared folder: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0B_kickoff_novamed

Action items (quick):
- Priyom: confirm you can lead SSO segment + share one slide by EOD today
- Grace: draft invite and include dial-in + recording settings; set up calendar invite after Priyom confirms
- Olga: flag any pre-reads you want to include (examples: model mapping doc)

Thanks —
Markus

Attachment stubs: redwood_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf (1 page), novamed_attendee_roster.csv (1 row template)

> Priyom: can you prepare a 10–15m slide with SSO metadata fields we need, and a checklist for network/firewall rules?

Yes — I'll prepare a 2-slide pack: 1) SSO metadata & certificate exchange steps, 2) minimal network egress ports / IP ranges and expected test plan. Will upload to the shared folder and send to the thread by 5pm PDT.

Also: recommend we add a 5m quick follow-up session two weeks later focused on test evidence and initial tokens-per-second performance expectations. I'll propose that in the invite.
